text:
lina_support: Hi @kevin, saw your support ticket about intermittent 502s when sending prompts from the Console UI. Can you please capture a network HAR + browser console logs so we can repro? We mainly need the failing request, the response headers (look for x-request-id), and a copy-as-cURL. Thanks!

kevin_customer: Yep — I can do that. I'm on Chrome on macOS. What exact steps should I follow so I don't miss anything?

lina_support: Quick checklist before capture: 1) Reproduce the error while DevTools is open, 2) Enable Network -> Preserve log, 3) Include response bodies when saving HAR, 4) Do NOT include your API key in uploads (redact before sending).

lina_support: Chrome steps (short):
- Open Chrome -> Menu -> More tools -> Developer tools (or Cmd+Option+I)
- In Network tab: check "Preserve log" and "Disable cache"
- Reproduce the issue (click the same button / perform same flow)
- Find the failing request in the Network list (status 5xx or 4xx)
- Click the request -> Headers -> Response Headers -> copy the value for x-request-id (or x-rw-request-id if present)
- Right-click the request -> "Copy" -> "Copy as cURL" and paste that into the ticket (remember to redact Authorization header)
- Right-click in Network list -> "Save all as HAR with content" -> save the .har file and attach it to the ticket or upload here

lina_support: Example cURL (redact token before sending):
```
curl 'https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/complete' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-raw '{"prompt":"test"}'
```

kevin_customer: Got it. Where should I look for the x-request-id in the response?

lina_support: In the request details -> Headers -> Response Headers. It often looks like: x-request-id: 9f1a2b3c-...
If you can't find it, paste the Copy-as-cURL output and we can extract it.

kevin_customer: One more — how do I get console logs? The app shows an error stack in console.

lina_support: Console logs: in DevTools -> Console panel -> right-click -> "Save as..." (or select the lines -> copy -> paste). Make sure the Console is open before you reproduce so you capture the error stack and any network console messages.

lina_support: Safari quick notes: Develop -> Show Web Inspector -> Network tab -> Enable "Preserve Log" -> reproduce -> right-click -> Export -> Save as HAR. (Safari may require the Develop menu to be enabled in Preferences -> Advanced).

lina_support: Edge: same flow as Chrome (DevTools -> Network -> Preserve log -> reproduce -> Save as HAR with content).

mike_eng: if you paste the HAR we want: failing request entry, response status/body, and the x-request-id. If you can also include the Copy-as-cURL that makes it faster to replay locally.

kevin_customer: Uploading now — attaching har + console.txt and I'm pasting the cURL (redacted). Also including the time it happened: 2026-03-16 21:12:04 UTC.

kevin_customer: cURL pasted: `curl 'https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/chat' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -H 'x-request-id: abc123-xyz' --data-raw '{"input":"hello"}'`

lina_support: Perfect, thanks. A couple final asks: 1) include browser + OS version (Chrome 113 / macOS 12.4 etc.), 2) any repro steps (exact clicks), 3) if you can reproduce reliably, try an incognito window to rule out extensions.

ci-bot: Uploaded files will be scanned for PII. If any sensitive values are found please redact and re-upload.

lina_support: We'll triage once we have the HAR + console. If we need a remote session we'll ask for a short screenshare. Thanks — we'll keep you updated here :thumbsup:
